experiments.procedure_text: OVCAR5 cells injected subcutaneously into nude mice; mice treated daily with 673A and/or AZD1390 or AZD6738 by oral gavage; tumors measured.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: This cell suspension was injected subcutaneously into the axillary region of nude mice
experiments.test_system_evidence: injected subcutaneously into the axillary region of nude mice
experiments.application_evidence: 673A enhances the effects of ATM/ATR inhibitors in a mouse xenograft model
experiments.route_evidence: injected subcutaneously into the axillary region of nude mice

endpoints.label: Tumor growth / tumor volume
endpoints.evidence: Tumors were measure by caliper and volume was calculated

endpoints.label: γ-H2AX levels in tumors (DNA damage)
endpoints.evidence: Immunofluorescence images of γ-H2AX levels in mouse tumors

substances.name: 673A
substances.evidence: Mice were injected daily with vehicle or 20 mg/kg 673A

substances.name: AZD 6738
substances.evidence: 50 mg/kg AZD 6738 by oral gavage daily

exposure.timing: given 3 days to engraft before treatments were started

experiments.exposure_evidence: Mice were injected daily with vehicle or 20 mg/kg 673A and/or given vehicle, 20 mg/kg AZD1390, or 50 mg/kg AZD 6738
experiments.notes: 673A dosing route (injected) not explicitly stated as a named route beyond daily injection; AZD inhibitors by oral gavage. Cell culture, comet, ALDEFLUOR, western, RT-qPCR, IF and CRISPR work are in vitro and not animal experiments.
